import awkward as ak

from pocket_coffea.lib.cut_definition import Cut


def dimuon_mask(events, params, **kwargs):
    """Event passes if it has >=2 muons above pt threshold with an opposite-charge leading pair."""
    muons = events.Muon
    good_muons = muons[muons.pt > params["pt_threshold"]]

    has_two_muons = ak.num(good_muons, axis=1) >= 2

    padded = ak.pad_none(good_muons, 2, axis=1)
    leading = padded[:, 0]
    subleading = padded[:, 1]
    opposite_charge = (leading.charge * subleading.charge) < 0

    mask = has_two_muons & opposite_charge
    return ak.fill_none(mask, False)


dimuon_cut = Cut(
    name="dimuon",
    params={"pt_threshold": 15},
    function=dimuon_mask,
)
